findings.title: No re-check of cache after acquiring write lock
findings.body: After the read-locked check fails, every concurrent caller blocks on Lock() and then reloads the manifest from disk. On a cold start, N concurrent requests each re-read and re-parse the manifest (and possibly fetch from the CDN), because the cache is not re-checked once the write lock is held. This is the classic double-checked locking omission. Re-check `entryPointAssetsCache != nil && cfg.Env != setting.Dev` after Lock() to avoid redundant work.

findings.title: Cache overwritten with nil result when loading fails
findings.body: `entryPointAssetsCache = result` is assigned even when err != nil, so result is nil. A transient failure (e.g. a missing manifest) wipes a previously valid cache entry. The function then returns (nil, err), which callers may dereference. Only store the result when err == nil.
